ai.purpose: RTT/1 engine layer for Morphic Resonance: operator grammar, recurrence behavior, pattern activation, and minimal coherence examples.

engine.description: Defines the operator grammar and dimensional behavior of pattern recurrence, activation, and cross-temporal coherence.

pattern_operator.description: Represents the underlying operator structure that defines a pattern.

activation_operator.description: Activates a pattern when resonance thresholds are met.

recurrence_operator.description: Describes how patterns recur across time or instances.

coherence_link.description: Links similar patterns across systems or epochs.

dimensional_anchor.description: Anchors a pattern to a stable dimensional configuration.

lineage_trace.description: Tracks recurrence across time or system instances.

resonance_threshold.description: Defines the minimum coherence required for activation.

cross_temporal_mapping.description: Maps patterns across temporal or dimensional boundaries.

dimensional_mapping.R1: Weak recurrence; unstable coherence; primitive pattern activation.
dimensional_mapping.R2: Stable operator structure; predictable recurrence; strong activation.
dimensional_mapping.R3: Cross-temporal resonance; lineage-level stability; high coherence.

integration.notes: RTT/1 treats Morphic Resonance as a dimensional recurrence grammar; deeper resonance and substrate integration occur in RTT/2 and RTT/3.
